steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each request is placed by its approver and its expiry.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Access requested with no approver
findings.fix: Record the approver before the grant

findings.title: Access above the role's standard
findings.fix: Reduce the access to the role's standard

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] req-1042.md:12  Access requested with no approver.
       Fix: Record the approver before the grant.
[medium] req-1046.md:19  Access above the role's standard.
       Fix: Reduce the access to the role's standard.
[low] req-1044.md:26  Grant with no expiry.
       Fix: Set an expiry date.
Not checked: Whether the access is used.
pros: Flags a request with no approver, access above the role's standard, and a grant with no expiry.
cons: Not checked: Whether the access is used.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-access-request skill on the records for this review.
